title: Sighting map clusters around Trinity Site
summary: James Fox tells of Sighting map clusters around Trinity Site, about 1940s-1950s cases at Mexico (no place named), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: the proximity to Trinity site was unbelievable

plain: James Fox, a documentary filmmaker known for a film called The Phenomenon, says that when UFO sightings from the 1940s and 1950s were plotted on a map, they bunched up around Trinity Site, the spot in the New Mexico desert where the first atomic bomb was tested. Drawing on the work of researchers Lance Mungia and Robert Hastings, he says "the proximity to Trinity site was unbelievable." If true, it would suggest that whatever people were seeing was drawn to the birthplace of nuclear weapons.
